full_cpu_rebuild_before_fix.explanation: the normal pass of the Cycles bake is not bit-stable run to run on the CPU (the other four maps are): the difference is at float16 LSB level in 102 texels and flips the 8-bit rounding of 10 texels of the 4K map; the likely source is the tangent-space path (multithreaded MikkTSpace tangents of the low-poly), not fixed. EEVEE preview frames differ by 1-2 LSB with identical inputs; probe PNGs differ only by metadata.

gpu_note.decision: profile bake.device = CPU (about 20 min for the five 4K maps vs 10-15 min on the shared GPU)
gpu_note.gpu_vs_cpu_float: max |d| 4.9e-4 on normal/basecolor/roughness/metallic, AO max 0.0117 on 5 texels (share 5.5e-7): device choice changes bytes, not the look
gpu_note.two_full_gpu_runs: OptiX (RTX 4090): meshes, UVs, FBX and the non-texture reports identical, 53 of 72 files different (all textures)

full_cpu_rebuild_before_fix.method: the whole chain run twice from the source GLBs (stages source..sheets, Cycles on the CPU, seed 0), sha256 of every file in export/, textures/, reports/, preview/ compared (72 files)
full_cpu_rebuild_before_fix.provenance: measured 2026-09-29 before the host-path fix: two complete CPU rebuilds (stages source..sheets) in the same run directory, compared file by file with an ad hoc script that was not kept. Not regenerable from the committed files: it needs a second full rebuild (about 26 min on the CPU, bake about 20 min) into another run directory and determinism.py (section other_directory shows that comparison for the stages maps..sheets)

superseded_by_the_fix.export/*.fbx: identical between those two runs, but both carried the absolute path of work/h2-rig.blend in Original|ApplicationNativeFile; now empty (fix_vs_pre_fix) and identical across run directories (other_directory)
superseded_by_the_fix.preview/deform/*.png: the metadata that made them differ (Blender render stamps incl. the .blend path) is dropped by run.py probe; now byte-identical across runs (other_directory)
superseded_by_the_fix.textures/T_Merlin_H2_N_OpenGL_{4K,2K}.pn: no longer written (the preview flips G of N in the shader); the normal-map remark applies to N_{4K,2K}
